bomb_blast.name: Bomb
bomb_blast.description: A fused ball of powder, lit where you stand.
bomb_blast.cast_message: You light the fuse and step back. The bomb goes off with a crack and a cloud of grit.

fire_arrow.name: Arrow
fire_arrow.description: Loose an arrow at one enemy. It costs a rupee.
fire_arrow.cast_message: You draw the bow and loose an arrow.

throw_whirlwing.name: Whirlwing
throw_whirlwing.description: Throw the whirlwing: it stuns what it strikes and comes back.
throw_whirlwing.cast_message: You throw the whirlwing, and it spins out and comes back to your hand.
throw_whirlwing.hit_message: The whirlwing cracks against {target_name} for {value} damage!

spit_big.name: Spit Rock
spit_big.description: A rock the size of a fist, spat across the room.
spit_big.cast_message: {caster_name} gulps and spits a rock at you.

spit_stone.name: Spit Stone
spit_stone.description: A stone spat across the room.
spit_stone.cast_message: {caster_name} gulps and spits a stone at you.

hurl_whirlwing.name: Hurl
hurl_whirlwing.cast_message: {caster_name} hurls a curved stick at you.
hurl_whirlwing.hit_message: The stick cracks against {target_name} for {value} damage!

aquilor_flame.name: Drake Flame
aquilor_flame.cast_message: {caster_name} spits a ball of fire at you.
aquilor_flame.hit_message: The fire washes over {target_name} for {value} damage!

hand_grab.name: Grasp
hand_grab.description: A cold hand reaches out of the wall and carries you off.
hand_grab.cast_message: {caster_name} closes on you out of the wall.

teleport.message: The hand drags you through the wall and lets go at the door you came in by.
